We share an unwavering commitment to supporting Ukraine and confronting Russia’s invasion of its peaceful neighbor, including through the recent announcement of additional supplies for Ukraine’s brave defenders, as well as assistance resettling Ukrainian refugees. The United States, Canada, and all our NATO Allies share a commitment to diplomacy as the most durable path for building lasting security.
The United States and Canada are working closely with our partners to provide support to achieve stability, safety, and health for Haiti.
Our countries remain committed to the people of Afghanistan, including through humanitarian efforts and resettling refugees.
The United States and Canada stand with Iranian women and all the citizens of Iran who are inspiring the world with their bravery.
